Name: Philip
Summary: Philip was an apostle from Bethsaida who brought Nathanael to Jesus and later, in Acts, led the Ethiopian official to faith in a desert-road encounter. He asked Jesus to show them the Father at the Last Supper.
KeyStory: Philip told a questioning Nathanael simply, Come and see — and Nathanael met Jesus and believed.
LifeLesson: 'Come and see' is an invitation anyone can offer. You do not need all the answers to bring someone to Jesus — just bring them to Him.
